fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) fell 13.9% on November 20, with the semiconductor sector overall showing weakness as the S&P 500 declined 3.7%, reflecting AI-related concerns.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron's fiscal Q4 revenue was $54.2 billion, up 379.3% year-over-year, but the stock has declined 30.6% over the past month, trading at $594.51, down approximately 51% from its June high of $1,213.56.
